name: Tabata Something Else
description: Four Tabata intervals back to back with no rest between them: pull-ups, push-ups, sit-ups and air squats. The score is the total reps across all 32 work intervals.
source_notes: crossfit.com/workout/2017/08/25 (official CrossFit daily workout archive), retrieved 2026-10-16; 8 intervals of 20 seconds on, 10 off for each movement, no rest between movements, score the total reps of all 32 intervals
